newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: London insurance bodies form joint working party.
newsitem.headline: London insurance bodies form joint working party.

text.p: The two trade bodies representing London insurance and reinsurance companies have set up a joint team to investigate ways of working closer together.

Phillip Marcell, chairman of the London International Insurance and Reinsurance Market Association (LIRMA), told a conference in Dublin on Tuesday night that the team will ask members their views on closer co-operation with the Institute of London Underwriters (ILU).

The move is being seen by many market observers as a prelude to a merger of LIRMA and the ILU aimed at cutting costs and strengthening the profile and lobbying ability of the London insurance companies market.
However, LIRMA officials stressed that merger is not formally on the agenda of joint discussions.
